scope: Rolling lifecycle safe broadcast diagnostics; no public payloads, retry policy, source SDK or build change.
sourceAssessment: Three existing onceAztecOperation call sites opt into observeBroadcast: constructor; L1 deploy-portal/activate; L2 bind/register. No new helper, lifecycle, timer or replay branch.

seedBroadcastFailure reads own data descriptors, allows finite HTTP/RPC/code fields only, never raw exception text, request, URL or hostile getter values.

Diagnostic-write failure preserves already durable prepared intent and returns unresolved. Retained calls reconcile before execute; cannot send again. Both successful and failed metadata persistence remain no-replay.
Historical records without classification still reconcile unchanged. This does not backfill or infer the original registration failure.
